hooks.name: ui-typecheck-and-tests
hooks.description: A component under web/src/ was saved. Type check the web package and run the tests related to the changed files.

action.command: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web test -- --changed --passWithNoTests

hooks.name: ui-tokens-and-motion-review
hooks.description: A new component was created under web/src/. Check it uses palette tokens only and respects prefers-reduced-motion. Reports; never edits.

action.prompt:
A new React component was just created under web/src/. Read it and any CSS file it imports, then report. Do not edit any file.

Check:
1. No raw colour values: no hex (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa), rgb(), rgba(), hsl() or named CSS colours in the component, its inline styles or its CSS. Colours come only from the custom properties in web/src/styles/tokens.css (the only file in web/src/ allowed to hold hex values; report/report.tokens.css is the Report's own token file). A canvas drawing call that sets a colour must read it from those custom properties too.
2. Token use follows .kiro/steering/design.md: lantern only for the pinned lot and primary actions, never for selection or decoration; water only for documented water; the Report route uses only the report tokens.
3. Motion: any CSS transition or animation, and any JavaScript animation (requestAnimationFrame loops, tweens, scrolling with behavior: smooth), is turned off or replaced by a crossfade when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is set, either by a media query or by reading the Shell's reduced-motion state. Nothing loops or pulses while idle.
4. Interactive elements keep a visible focus ring (no outline: none without a replacement).

Reply with one line per problem: file, line, rule number, what to change. If there are none, reply "UI check: no problems" with the file name.
